figurative_meaning_en: Even the trivial words of noble people are valuable
similar_in_english: Even the scraps from the rich are treasures
The great man's leavings are the poor man's riches
example_sentences_in_bangla: তাঁর কথা শোনো, বড়মাছের কাঁটাও ভালো।
সে বিখ্যাত লেখক, তাঁর তুচ্ছ মন্তব্যও আমাদের জন্য মূল্যবান।
example_sentences_in_english: Listen to him; even the bones of a big fish are good.
He is a renowned scholar; even his casual remark is valuable to us.
note: This idiom reflects traditional Bengali respect for social superiors and their utterances.
